# Ultralytics YOLOv5-n6 (v6.1)

Object Detection · `yolov5-n6_1280x1280_v6.1` · DX-APP Python example

Object Detection model, evaluated on COCO.

**Input** 1280 × 1280 × 3 · **Dataset** COCO · **License** GPL-3.0 · **Quantization** Q-Lite, Q-Pro

![Ultralytics YOLOv5-n6 (v6.1) output](result.webp)

Full card with copy buttons and dark/light theme (open it in a browser; GitHub shows its source): [model.html](model.html)

## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models yolov5n6_6.1
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/object_detection/yolov5/yolov5-n6_1280x1280_v6.1/yolov5-n6_1280x1280_v6.1_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/yolov5-n6_1280x1280_v6.1.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_street.jpg
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target yolov5-n6_1280x1280_v6.1_sync   # once
./bin/yolov5-n6_1280x1280_v6.1_sync \
  -m assets/models/yolov5-n6_1280x1280_v6.1.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_street.jpg
```

## Accuracy

| Quantization | mAP |
|---|---:|
| Raw · ONNX | 35.37 |
| Q-Lite | 34.82 (−0.55) |
| Q-Pro | 34.87 (−0.50) |

COCO · difference vs Raw in brackets.
